metadata.dispatch: SnapAI Install-Year Decoder + Replace-Decision Data Research Dispatch v1.1 — Track 2
key_findings: Refrigerant 2025+ SPLITS BY MANUFACTURER: Carrier/Bryant/Payne/Trane/American Standard/Lennox/Rheem/Ruud/York/Heil = R-454B; Goodman/Amana/Daikin/most mini-splits = R-32 (Daikin is R-32 champion); MrCool = R-454B. Critical for the 'must replace, cannot recharge' decision.
Reversing-valve replacement full job confirmed $625-1900 (US 2025) — the dispatch $400-800 adder UNDERSTATES a full job with A2L reclaim. JCI/ICP brands quote $400-800 (parts+labor only).
Package units carry SHORTER expected lifespan than split AC (rooftop exposure) — reflected in Carrier/Lennox package records.
Lifespan figures are climate-adjusted ESTIMATES (Houston humidity+run-hours; PK dust+voltage+heat), NOT measured field-failure actuarial data. All flagged.
PK: strong repair culture + cheap labor + gas-refill economics shift repair-vs-replace threshold vs US; Japanese (Daikin/Mitsubishi) parts scarcity pushes replace earlier for gray imports.
PK adulterated/counterfeit refrigerant is a documented failure accelerant AND corrupts the refrigerant-as-decade-cue used for Mitsubishi serial dating.
metadata.variant_note: US ducted brands exploded into split_ac/package_unit/heat_pump variants; package lifespan derived (-3 yr rooftop), heat_pump carries reversing-valve adder. Mini-split + PK records carry single variant.

record_provenance.note: Of the US records, only split_ac (+ mini_split) are independently researched; package_unit and heat_pump rows are formula-derived from the split_ac base (package = lifespan -3yr rooftop; heat_pump = same lifespan + reversing-valve adder) and share the base record's sources. Confidence on derived rows is tagged '(variant-derived)'. Honest count of independently-researched brand-tier records: see genuinely_researched_records.

v1_2_changelog: ADDED 24 Nortek brand-tier-variant records (Frigidaire/Maytag/Westinghouse/NuTone/Gibson/Tappan x entry/mid/premium x split_ac/package_unit/heat_pump).

Nortek 2025+ refrigerant VERIFIED = R-454B (NOT R-32) — Nordyne official A2L page + 2025 Frigidaire R-454B spec sheets (National Air Warehouse) + Rheem acquisition. Puts Nortek in the R-454B camp with Carrier/JCI/Rheem.
Nortek is value-positioned (sits below Carrier/Trane); Houston install costs anchored to distributor + Modernize data.
All new records cr_substituted + confidence demoted to low per v1.1 confidence_recompute rule.
